Show real-time floating overlay with CPU, GPU, RAM, and temperature metrics over other apps
AxDiagnostics needs permission to draw over other apps to display the performance overlay.
Monitoring is disabled to avoid battery drain.\nEnable only when actively debugging.

Tap Start to begin recording battery drain.

The monitor tracks:
 - Current draw (mA) every 5 seconds
 - Battery level changes over time
 - Screen on/off state correlation
 - Drain rate per hour (5m, 15m, 30m, 1hr windows)
 - Screen-on vs screen-off drain rates
 - Hourly breakdown when tracking >1hr

Leave it running while using the device normally
to measure real-world drain behavior.

Tap Start to begin monitoring all process memory.

The detector tracks RSS for every process and flags:
 - Monotonic growth (RSS only goes up)
 - Growth rate (KB/min)
 - Linear correlation (how steady the growth is)
 - Absolute growth amount

Confidence levels:
 CERTAIN — strong monotonic growth + high correlation
 HIGH — consistent growth pattern
 MEDIUM — noticeable growth with some noise
 LOW — some growth but inconclusive

Run for 5-10 minutes for meaningful results.
Longer = more accurate leak detection.

Enabling the monitoring service can increase battery drain while it collects data for accurate statistics.
Live health from CPU, memory, battery, storage, thermal, I/O, and wakelock collectors.

Monitors all processes over time and flags:
 - CPU spikes (>40% sudden jump)
 - Sustained CPU (>15% for 10+ samples)
 - Memory leaks (steady RSS growth >20%)
 - Memory spikes (+50MB sudden jump)
 - Thread growth (+10 threads)
